statements.statement: The claim was denied under CO-197
The denial reason is that required prior authorization was not obtained
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and exertional dyspnea
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management
